as_told.title: Soldier Marco Chereze dies after capturing a being

plain: A soldier named Marco Eli Chereze is said to have died after handling a strange being captured in the Brazilian town of Varginha in 1996, a creature that Michels says was covered in an oily, greasy substance. Michels tells it on several episodes. In one he credits Chereze's family, who still hold that the being caused his illness and say that near the end he kept worrying that holding it had made him sick. In another he says, crediting a man named Armando Fortunato, that Chereze died from a puncture wound the being gave him.
